These drugs, in turn, have a common target: the High affinity immunoglobulin gamma Fc receptor I. This suggests a possible indirect pathway where IgG, through its interaction with Lymphotoxin-alpha, may influence the function of the Fc receptor I, potentially modulating immune responses. The scores from the paths indicate a consistent pattern of interaction, with varying levels of confidence, but all pointing toward a mechanistic link. The evidence supports a plausible biological mechanism, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
